standouts.head: Strong uptrend (ADX 27)
standouts.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 27, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with buyers in control of the directional lines.
standouts.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.

against.head: Behind SPY
against.text: Against SPY it is −6% over three months.
against.learn: How the stock has done against its fund (QQQ for tech, chips and internet names, SPY for the rest); leaders lead.

material.head: Support −2.1% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −2.1% below (0.8 ATR), where 6 levels (4 kinds) meet: the Mar 20 low, the 50-day average and the average price paid since the Aug 6 high.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Bounce in a downtrend
material.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
material.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

material.head: Resistance +1.2% above
material.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.2% above (0.5 ATR), where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet: the Jun 11 low, the 200-day average and the 61.8% retracement of the Aug 6–Oct 6 drop: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
material.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

material.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average
material.text: It closed back above its 50-day average in the last three sessions.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Accumulation
material.text: In five weeks it had 5 up days and 1 down day on volume above both the day before and its average.
material.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.
